messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @eve-oncall @alice-sre - High spike in 429s across token-accounting service (rate limiter). Root cause suspected after recent deploy. Please acknowledge.

Eve-oncall: acked. I'm looking now. Can you drop the alert link?

incident-bot: Alert: https://prometheus.redwood.internal/alerts/429-spike-tokenflow — 5xx stable, 429s increased 8x in last 3m. Top traces show 'rlv2' path.

Alice-sre: saw it. TL;DR: rollout of token-routing change this morning; seems exemptions lookup is returning empty for many accounts, so requests are being reclassified and over-throttled.

Ben-eng: confirming. We pushed rollout 08:17 UTC — feature flag: token-routing-v2=gradual. Canary looked fine for small sample, but global traffic pattern exposed a cache miss in exemption index.

Carla-support: we already have 4 customers reporting 429 errors for long-running embed jobs. Support queue ++. Which customers?

Alice-sre: preliminary top-impact: acme-ads, lumen-ai, fitlytics. They show sustained 429s for 2+ minutes, some retries timed out.

Dave-ops: I'm running a query to check exemption lookup hit-rate. snippet: ```sql
SELECT count(*) as misses, service, region FROM exemption_cache_events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '10 minutes' GROUP BY service, region ORDER BY misses DESC LIMIT 10;
```

Ben-eng: results: exemption_cache miss rate jumped from ~0.5% to 57% after deploy for token-accounting index shards in us-west-2. Also seeing a spike in redis timeouts and fallback path that clears exemptions.

Eve-oncall: can we flip the rollout flag back to v1 or kill the new flag? Need fast mitigation.

Ben-eng: agreed. I'm going to flip `token-routing-v2` to off in the feature-flag service. Command: `flagsctl set token-routing-v2 false --env=prod --scope=global`

Ben-eng: done. Flag flipped at 08:24:31 UTC. Pushing a coordinated kill-switch to avoid partial mismatches.

incident-bot: Flag change detected: token-routing-v2=false (user: ben-eng) — binding propagated to 85% of edge proxies in ~18s.

Alice-sre: seeing 429s dropping. Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rl/tokenflow-ratecap — 429 rate back to baseline within 40s of flag flip.

Carla-support: customers reporting recovery. acme-ads says jobs resumed. Filing incident tickets and notifying account owners.

Dave-ops: we still see token-count drift in billing pipeline for a small subset — token accounting job processed partial batches during the rollback window. I'll run a reconciliation.

Ben-eng: root cause summary (WIP): a cache invalidation race in the new token-routing index caused temporary empty exemption sets. This led to default ratecap paths firing (over-throttle) for affected tenants. The config change didn't include a safewarm step for the exemption cache.

Eve-oncall: mitigation checklist: 1) flag flip (done), 2) rollback on-call runbook to check related dependents (Alice), 3) reconcile billing tokens (Dave), 4) follow-up postmortem owner and timeline (Ben). Any other immediate mitigations?

Alice-sre: I'll run smoke for dependent services and watch error budgets. Also adding short-lived routing rule to prefer cached exemptions while we fix warmup.

Dave-ops: started reconciliation job at 08:33 UTC: `python tools/reconcile_tokens.py --window=10m --service=token-accounting --dry-run=false` — ETA ~25m. Will post results.

Ben-eng: assigning postmortem owner: @ben-eng. ETA for draft: EOD. We'll include customer impact, timeline, code diff, and safewarm plan.

Carla-support: I'll send customer comms template to accounts for impacted tenants and coordinate credits if billing drift confirmed.

Eve-oncall: good work. Keep this thread updated with reconciliation and timeline. If 429s reappear escalate to P0.

Alice-sre: note for the postmortem: consider adding automated canary traffic profile that simulates large tenant exemption tables. Current canary missed that shape.

Dave-ops: reconciliation done at 08:58 UTC — found ~1.2% token accounting mismatch for affected window. Running corrective patch to reapply missing tokens. Will validate with ledger counters.

Carla-support: created INC-3842 for customer notifications and linked to support tickets.

Ben-eng: rolling a hotfix to add safewarm step to deploy pipeline and ensure cache priming: PR#4821. Will require a small infra migration. Planning to ship after review; target tomorrow AM low-traffic window.

Eve-oncall: closing the immediate incident as mitigated but keeping thread open for postmortem follow-ups. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
